restaurant.name: Mawlana Restaurant
restaurant.description: One of Herat's most well-known dining spots, offering an innovative blend of traditional ambiance and modern hospitality. The first venue in Herat to feature an exhibition of stone, pottery, and traditional crafts. Specialises in Dizi, Kozeh Kebab, and a wide variety of kebabs.
restaurant.description_dari: یکی از معروف‌ترین رستوران‌های هرات که ترکیبی از محیط سنتی و مهمان‌نوازی مدرن را ارائه می‌دهد.

restaurant.name: Char Fasl Restaurant
restaurant.description: Chahar Fasl (Four Seasons) Restaurant, Branch 1, with a diverse menu of local and international dishes, provides a calm and family-friendly environment. High quality, friendly service, and a welcoming atmosphere. Family area, parking, and online reservation available.
restaurant.description_dari: رستورانت چهار فصل با منوی متنوع از غذاهای محلی و بین‌المللی، محیطی آرام و خانوادگی ارائه می‌دهد.
restaurant.address: Gulha Circle, first of North Street
restaurant.landmark: Gulha Circle, first of North Street

restaurant.name: Qoqnoos Restaurant
restaurant.description: Inspired by the legend of the Phoenix — a symbol of freshness, growth, and rebirth — Qoqnoos Restaurant offers a warm and inviting atmosphere. With a diverse menu of local and international dishes, high-quality service, and a beautiful environment. Family area, online reservation, and parking available.
restaurant.description_dari: رستورانت ققنوس با الهام از افسانه ققنوس، نمادی از تازگی و رشد، محیطی گرم و دلپذیر ارائه می‌دهد.
restaurant.address: Pol Poshto Street (Airport Road), adjacent to Injil Clinic
restaurant.landmark: Adjacent to Injil Clinic, Airport Road

restaurant.name: Food Box Restaurant
restaurant.description: Food Box is a modern fast-food restaurant in Herat offering a diverse menu of burgers, pizza, sandwiches, Turkish doner, Arabic trays, and quick meals. Located at Mostofiat Crossroads. Rated 4.9 on Mizban — one of the highest-rated restaurants in Herat.
restaurant.description_dari: فود باکس یک رستورانت فست‌فود مدرن در هرات است که منوی متنوعی از برگر، پیتزا، دونر ترکی و سینی‌های عربی ارائه می‌دهد.
restaurant.address: Mustofiat Crossroads, towards the back of Tarqa Park, opposite Ahmad Shah Baba 7
restaurant.landmark: Mustofiat Crossroads, opposite Ahmad Shah Baba 7

restaurant.name: Parmis Restaurant
restaurant.description: Parmis Restaurant in Herat offers a warm and inviting atmosphere, making it an ideal place for family and friends to gather. Famous for its Koobideh Kebab and soup. Delivers fast and professional service. Family area, parking, and online reservation available.
restaurant.description_dari: رستورانت پارمیس در هرات با محیطی گرم و دلپذیر، مکانی ایده‌آل برای خانواده و دوستان است. معروف به کباب کوبیده و سوپ.
restaurant.address: Tank Markaz, near Kabul Bank, National Hero 16
restaurant.landmark: Near Kabul Bank, National Hero 16, Tank Markaz

restaurant.name: New Mahtab Shinwari
restaurant.description: Nawi Mahtab Shinwari is a traditional restaurant in Herat offering a variety of delicious and authentic Shinwari dishes of high quality. The restaurant provides a warm and inviting atmosphere, ideal for family and friends to gather. Family area and online reservation available.
restaurant.description_dari: رستورانت نوی مهتاب شینواری یک رستورانت سنتی در هرات است که غذاهای اصیل شینواری با کیفیت بالا ارائه می‌دهد.
restaurant.address: Blood Bank Road (Jade Bank-e-Khoon), in front of Qamar Clinic
restaurant.landmark: In front of Qamar Clinic, Blood Bank Road

restaurant.name: Istanbul Doner & Pizza House
restaurant.description: Doner & Pizza Saray Istanbul Restaurant offers a variety of traditional Turkish doner and Turkish-style pizza (pide/zoj), prepared with fresh and high-quality ingredients. Specialises in authentic Turkish cuisine in the heart of Herat.
restaurant.description_dari: رستورانت دونر و پیتزا سرای استانبول انواع دونر ترکی سنتی و پیتزای به سبک ترکی را با مواد تازه و باکیفیت ارائه می‌دهد.
restaurant.address: Ameriat District, opposite Afghan Salamat Clinic
restaurant.landmark: Opposite Afghan Salamat Clinic, Ameriat District

restaurant.name: Darbar Herat Restaurant
restaurant.description: Darbar Herat Restaurant with authentic Afghan flavors and Herati taste. Offers free and fast motorcycle delivery. Located in the heart of Herat city. Opened in 2025.
restaurant.description_dari: رستورانت دربار هرات با طعم‌های اصیل افغانی و مزه هراتی. دیلیوری رایگان و سریع موتر دارد.
restaurant.address: Tank Markaz, next to Super Cola representative
restaurant.landmark: Next to Super Cola representative, Tank Markaz

restaurant.name: Isteqlal Restaurant
restaurant.description: The Freedom Restaurant — traditional Afghan and Middle Eastern cuisine. Located in an excellent location in Herat City near Bagh-e-Mellat. Rated 4.0 on TripAdvisor.
restaurant.description_dari: رستورانت استقلال — غذاهای سنتی افغانی و خاورمیانه‌ای. در موقعیت عالی در شهر هرات نزدیک باغ ملت.

restaurant.name: Arghawan Restaurant
restaurant.description: A very pleasant restaurant, especially in summer when you can eat in the small courtyard. Specialises in kebabs. Located in the city centre of Herat.
restaurant.description_dari: رستورانت ارغوان، مکانی بسیار دلپذیر، به ویژه در تابستان که می‌توانید در حیاط کوچک غذا بخورید. متخصص کباب.

restaurant.name: Hazar Dastan Café
restaurant.description: A clean, modern, and fragrant snack café in Herat. Modern ambiance with café-style snacks and beverages.
restaurant.description_dari: کافه هزار داستان یک کافه اسنک تمیز، زنده، مدرن و معطر در هرات است.

restaurant.name: Mahtab Restaurant
restaurant.description: A traditional tea house and restaurant with white tables and chairs. Located in the city centre of Herat. Traditional Afghan cuisine and takeaway.
restaurant.description_dari: یک چایخانه و رستورانت سنتی با میزها و صندلی‌های سفید. در مرکز شهر هرات.
restaurant.address: Shar-e-Now, Bank-e-Khoon Road (Blood Bank Road), corner of Ismail Khan Road
restaurant.landmark: Corner of Ismail Khan Road and Blood Bank Road, Shar-e-Now
